typography.strategy: Swiss Brutalist meets Tech. Radical contrast between highly technical headings and highly legible sterile monospace/sans body.
rules: DO NOT use Inter, Roboto, or generic Sans for headings.
Headlines > 32px MUST use tracking-tight or tracking-tighter.
Overlines and table headers must be Uppercase, Tiny, and Wide Spacing.
Use JetBrains Mono for data points like phone numbers or rating scores.
Zero use of Teal Green or Teal Blue.
Use Electric Blaze (#FF3B30) strictly for 'No Website' tags to draw immediate sales rep attention.
Never use pure black #000000, use Deep Obsidian #0A0A0A.
Hover states must explicitly set text color (e.g., hover:bg-accent hover:text-white).

layouts.strategy: Sidebar + KPI Strip + Content Grid. Density and Data Correlation.
rules: Use CSS grid for the main layout structure.
No centered layouts for dashboard content. Left-align for scannability.
Use 'F-pattern' hierarchy: Main KPI top left.
Widgets must stretch to fill height using h-full. No jagged bottoms.

surfaces_and_borders.strategy: Grid Borders (Technical Look). Expose the skeleton.
surfaces_and_borders.cards: Flat background, 1px solid border (border-border), NO shadows. Radius 0.
surfaces_and_borders.hover_states: Slight lift (-translate-y-[1px]) with subtle border color darken/lighten.
surfaces_and_borders.headers: Solid Background with a hard bottom border. NEVER transparent.
rules: Avoid soft shadows. Replace with 1px solid strokes or 2px 'Inner Glow' highlights.
No Glassmorphism. This is a technical data app, refrain from visual refraction.

icons.usage: Use bold or regular weights. Perfect for dense dashboards.

specific_instructions.buttons: Sharp edges (rounded-none), high contrast. Use hover:bg-primary/90.
specific_instructions.tables: Dense. Use Shadcn Table. No rounded corners on rows. Clear horizontal borders.
specific_instructions.badges: Use sharp badges. Red for 'No Website', Green for 'Has Website', Yellow for 'Contacted'.
specific_instructions.forms: Use Shadcn Input, Select, Checkbox. Keep inputs sharp (rounded-none).
specific_instructions.dialogs: Solid dark background with 1px border. No backdrop blur, use a solid bg-black/80 overlay.

motion: Staggered entrance for list items in the lead table.
visual_enhancers.empty_states: Action-oriented empty states. If no scheduled searches exist, show a clear CTA to create one, accompanied by a subtle Phosphor icon.

rules: All interactive elements MUST have focus states with higher contrast (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary focus:ring-offset-background).
Ensure text meets APCA standards. White text on dark gray.
Include data-testid attributes on all interactive elements (e.g., data-testid='lead-table-row', data-testid='search-location-input').

media.strategy: Minimal media. Dashboard relies on data. Use background image only for the Login/Auth screen to create a 'Command Center' feel.

auth_background.description: Abstract black and white tactical texture for login page background overlay.
auth_background.usage: Use with bg-cover, bg-center and a heavy overlay (bg-background/90) so the login form is perfectly readable.

instructions_to_main_agent: Wipe existing App.css global centered styles. Left-align text by default.
Update tailwind.config.js to set radius to 0 for the sharp, technical look.
Install required fonts and icon libraries before building.
Build a persistent layout with a collapsible left sidebar (240px) and top header.
Implement Shadcn UI heavily but strip rounded corners to match the 'Performance Pro' archetype.
Always add data-testid attributes to your components for testing.
For the Lead Dashboard, use a dense table or grid of cards. Highlight the 'Website Status' metric heavily as it's the core driver for cold calling.
Use Recharts for the Analytics view. Use the provided chart colors in CSS variables.
Ensure '10 AM everyday' scheduled search config is highly visible in the Settings/Manager view.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not converge toward generic outputs. Avoid 'AI slop' aesthetics.
Do not center align the app container in App.css.
Always use modern button styles, specifically sharp-edged for this project.
NEVER use AI assistant emojis for icons.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy, even in dark mode.
